collection.title: Daihatsu Grand Move 1996 to 2002 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Daihatsu Grand Move 1996 to 2002 model which requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
